title: Executive Director, Global Commercial Development Operations
text:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

With our rapidly growing portfolio, geographic reach, and Global Commercial Development (GCD) organization, we are seeking an experienced and enterprise-minded Executive Director, Global Commercial Development Operations to develop and implement key business processes, lead department operations, and strengthen planning, communication, and execution as the organization scales. This position reports to the SVP of Global Commercial Development and will serve as a core member of the GCD Leadership Team.

The role will partner with GCD functional leaders, other operations teams, and key corporate functions to establish effective ways of working and clear ownership across shared initiatives. In collaboration with Commercialization Effectiveness and Operations, this role will align GCD planning and processes with the broader commercialization organization.

In addition, this leader will build and lead GCD operations, department project coordination capabilities, supporting disease area teams, Analytics and Insights, Commercialization Partnerships, Companion Diagnostics, and Global Commercial Excellence.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner closely with the Head of GCD, GCD functional leaders, and key partners including HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Information Systems, and Corporate Relations to guide and execute department strategies, plans, and deliverables.
* Establish and manage GCD financial and strategic planning processes, including annual goals, operating plans, budgets, projections, and business reviews. Partner with Finance and functional leaders to track resources, identify gaps, and coordinate inputs into broader commercialization planning cycles.
* Play a central role in defining GCD organizational goals and short- and long-term priorities. Track milestones, dependencies, and progress, and communicate risks and decisions required to the appropriate leaders.
* Lead and plan GCD Leadership Team meetings and other department decision-making forums, working with relevant leaders to set agendas, preparing materials, document decisions, and ensure follow-through on commitments.
* Coordinate GCD participation in broader commercialization business reviews, planning milestones, and shared initiatives, working with the ED, CGCO Operations and other relevant partners as needed. Translate agreed priorities and decisions into clear GCD actions and deliverables.
* Lead coordination of GCD management presentations, briefing materials, and FAQs for launch readiness, portfolio, business performance, and other key reviews. Coordinate with relevant owners to provide consistent GCD inputs for Board, earnings, and other executive engagements.
* Build and lead a GCD project coordination capability to advance department priorities. Define project ownership, plans, milestones, and escalation paths, coordinating dependencies with teams responsible for launch readiness and Global Commercialization Team management.
* Partner with Commercialization Effectiveness and Operations (CE&O) on selected shared planning processes, tools, and ways of working. Coordinate with Global Commercial Excellence (GCE) and other capability teams to clarify responsibilities and support effective implementation within GCD.
* Partner with the Head of GCD to develop and implement a department communication strategy. Coordinate team meetings, project highlights, leadership updates, offsites, and recognition activities to clarify priorities, communicate progress, and strengthen team connection.
* Optimize interfaces across GCD, regional commercial teams, Medical Affairs, Global Access, Research and Development, and corporate functions. Facilitate information sharing, clarify responsibilities, and resolve or escalate operational issues that affect shared priorities.
* Build and scale GCD project management, governance, planning, and operational reporting capabilities. Partner with Analytics and Insights and Information Systems on tools and dashboards that track department execution, resource needs, and organizational goals.
* Lead change management efforts to support organizational growth and drive adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working. Partner with HR and functional leaders on workforce planning, onboarding, role clarity, and team effectiveness, drawing on CE&O approaches where appropriate.
* Develop, grow, and lead a high-performing operations team, including department project coordinators. Coordinate capacity and support across GCD while working closely with project resources embedded in individual teams.
* Establish clear ownership of recurring GCD processes and workstreams with relevant functional leaders. Maintain documentation of processes, decisions, and open actions to support continuity as the organization evolves.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 15+ years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare, including significant experience leading cross functional commercial or commercialization initiatives.
* Experience supporting commercialization organizations, including complex operational planning, launch readiness or brand planning, and capability development.
* Demonstrated Executive Director-level capability, including defining operating models, building organizational capabilities, and driving cross-functional alignment in evolving organizations.
* Strong functional and operational leadership skills, including process design, governance, project management, financial and resource planning, performance management, and change management.
* Proven success partnering with internal stakeholders to improve organizational effectiveness.
* Experience working across global and regional teams, with the ability to clarify accountabilities and coordinate work across different functions and geographies.
* Experience building and leading high-performing operations, or project management teams.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, balancing strategic judgment with hands-on execution and disciplined follow-through.
* Exceptional collaboration, communication, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to synthesize complex issues into clear executive materials and actionable plans.
* Sound judgment and discretion when managing confidential information, sensitive organizational topics, and competing leadership priorities.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, or PhD.
* Oncology or specialty pharmaceutical commercialization experience.
* Experience partnering with an executive office or leadership team during rapid organizational growth and geographic expansion.

**#LI-JW1 #LI-Remote**

Our base pay salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Individual base pay salary is determined by multiple factors, including job-related skills, experience, market dynamics, and relevant education or training.

Please note that base pay salary range is one part of the overall total rewards program at RevMed, which includes competitive cash compensation, robust equity awards, strong benefits, and significant learning and development opportunities.
